EmailTemplate.name: Freight Email To Case Claims - International
EmailTemplate.subject: {!Case.Subject} - Qantas Freight Customer Support - {!Case.CaseNumber}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Thanks for contacting Qantas Freight. We’ve received your request and your reference number is {!Case.CaseNumber}.
This email is to let you know we've received your international intent to claim.
If your incident is covered and adheres to the time frames outlined in our international conditions of carriage please continue with your formal claim. If you are outside Australia, you can submit your formal claim to your local Qantas Freight office or ground handling agent where the freight was collected. If you are in Australia, please respond to this email with your formal claim submission; Reason for lodging the claim Number of affected pieces Weight of the affected pieces Amount claimed (value)
We will also require the following documentation to begin the formal claim process.
Copy of the MAWB and HAWB Copy of the packing list Copy of the commercial invoice Copy of the surveyors report evidencing the damage Confirmation if the goods have been repaired or salvaged Or in the event that the goods were destroyed or disposed of – we would need a copy of the destruction/disposal certificates. Confirmation if the goods had insurance and if any monies have been paid against this policy.
All the best, Qantas Freight Team www.qantasfreight.com
